preparation_rules: Never apply heat: Cooking or boiling causes vesicles to burst and collapse instantly.
Wash immediately before serving: Rinse in cool, clean water right before assembling.
Dress immediately prior to eating: Acid and salt extract water from the beads through osmosis within 5-10 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Filipino Ensaladang Lato (Seaweed Salad)
recipes.description: A classic side dish pairing crisp sea grapes with diced tomatoes, onions, and optional salted duck egg.
ingredients: 2 large ripe plum tomatoes (cored and finely diced)
1 piece salted duck egg (itlog na maalat, peeled and diced, optional)
1 thumb-sized piece fresh ginger (peeled and minced, optional)
3 tbsp cane vinegar or coconut vinegar
1 tbsp fresh calamansi juice or lime juice
instructions: Place fresh lato in a bowl of cold water. Gently pick out debris, sea stones, or damaged stems. Drain thoroughly.
Submerge the cleaned lato in a bowl of ice water for 2 to 3 minutes to maximize crispness. Drain well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the vinegar, calamansi juice, sugar, and cracked black pepper until the sugar dissolves. Stir in the diced tomatoes, red onions, and ginger.
Place the drained lato on a serving platter and top with the salted egg. Either pour the dressing over the top immediately before serving or serve the dressing on the side as a dip.

filipino.title: Klasikong Filipino Ensaladang Lato (Salad ng Seaweed)
filipino.description: Klasikong ulam na ipinapares ang malutong na lato sa hiniwang kamatis at sibuyas, at opsyonal na itlog na maalat.
ingredients: 2 malaking hinog na plum tomato (inalisan ng ubod at tinadtad nang pino)
1 itlog na maalat (binalatan at tinadtad, opsyonal)
1 hinlalaking piraso ng sariwang luya (binalatan at tinadtad, opsyonal)
3 tbsp suka ng tubo o suka ng niyog
1 tbsp sariwang katas ng kalamansi o katas ng dayap
1/2 tsp bagong-durog na itim na paminta
instructions: Ilagay ang sariwang lato sa mangkok ng malamig na tubig. Dahan-dahang alisin ang mga dumi, bato sa dagat, o sirang tangkay. Patuluin nang mabuti.
Ilubog ang nilinis na lato sa mangkok ng tubig na may yelo nang 2 hanggang 3 minuto upang maging malutong ito. Patuluin nang mabuti.
Sa hiwalay na mangkok, haluin ang suka, katas ng kalamansi, asukal, at dinurog na itim na paminta hanggang matunaw ang asukal. Ihalo ang tinadtad na kamatis, pulang sibuyas, at luya.
Ilagay ang pinatulong lato sa bandeha at patungan ng itlog na maalat. Ibuhos ang sawsawan sa ibabaw bago ihain o ihain ito sa tabi bilang sawsawan.

recipes.title: Okinawan Umi-Budo with Citrus Ponzu Dip
recipes.description: Fresh sea grapes served unadorned over crushed ice with a citrusy, savory ponzu dipping sauce.
ingredients: 1.5 tbsp yuzu juice, sudachi juice, or fresh lemon juice
instructions: Submerge umi-budo in clean, room-temperature or cool water for 1 to 2 minutes to reduce residual salinity. Drain completely.
Whisk together soy sauce, yuzu juice, dashi, mirin, and rice vinegar in a small dip ramekin.
Bed a plate with crushed ice, lay the fresh umi-budo clusters on top, and place the ponzu bowl alongside.
Dip individual fronds into the sauce right before biting. Avoid pouring the dip over the seaweed to keep the pearls firm.

filipino.title: Okinawan Umi-Budo na may Sawsawang Citrus Ponzu
filipino.description: Sariwang sea grapes na inihain nang walang dagdag na palamuti sa ibabaw ng dinurog na yelo, kasama ang malasang ponzu na may sitrus.
ingredients: 1.5 tbsp katas ng yuzu, sudachi, o sariwang lemon
instructions: Ilubog ang umi-budo sa malinis na tubig na may temperatura ng silid o malamig nang 1 hanggang 2 minuto upang mabawasan ang natitirang alat. Patuluin nang lubusan.
Haluin sa maliit na mangkok na pangsawsaw ang toyo, katas ng yuzu, dashi, mirin, at suka ng bigas.
Lagyan ng dinurog na yelo ang bandeha, ilagay sa ibabaw ang kumpol ng sariwang umi-budo, at itabi ang mangkok ng ponzu.
Isawsaw ang bawat dahon sa sarsa bago kagatin. Huwag ibuhos ang sawsawan sa seaweed upang manatiling matitibay ang mga butil.

recipes.title: Okinawan Umi-Budo Donburi (Sea Grape & Sashimi Rice Bowl)
recipes.description: A popular Izakaya rice bowl where sea grapes act as a popping textural contrast to fresh raw sashimi.
ingredients: 150 g sushi-grade yellowfin tuna or salmon (sliced for sashimi)
2 cups cooked Japanese short-grain rice (cooled to room temp)
1 piece egg yolk or poached/onsen egg (optional)
instructions: Gently fold seasoned rice vinegar into the cooked rice. Allow it to cool slightly so heat does not collapse the sea grapes.
Quick-rinse umi-budo in cool water and pat dry with paper towels.
Divide rice into two serving bowls. Lay shiso leaves on top, arrange sashimi slices along one side, and pile fresh umi-budo on the other side. Nest-egg the yolk in the center if desired.
Serve with wasabi and soy sauce on the side.

filipino.title: Okinawan Umi-Budo Donburi (Mangkok ng Kanin na may Sea Grape at Sashimi)
filipino.description: Sikat na mangkok ng kanin sa Izakaya kung saan nagbibigay ang sea grapes ng pumipitik na tekstura katabi ng sariwang hilaw na sashimi.
ingredients: 150 g tuna na yellowfin o salmon na angkop kainin bilang sashimi (hiniwa)
2 cups nilutong Japanese short-grain rice (pinalamig hanggang temperatura ng silid)
1 pula ng itlog o itlog na niluto sa tubig/onsen egg (opsyonal)
instructions: Dahan-dahang ihalo ang tinimplahang suka ng bigas sa nilutong kanin. Hayaang bahagyang lumamig upang hindi bumagsak ang mga butil ng sea grapes dahil sa init.
Mabilisang banlawan ang umi-budo sa malamig na tubig at patuyuin sa paper towel.

Hatiin ang kanin sa dalawang mangkok na paghahainan. Ilagay sa ibabaw ang dahon ng shiso, ayusin sa isang panig ang mga hiwa ng sashimi at sa kabila ang sariwang umi-budo. Kung nais, ilagay ang pula ng itlog sa gitna.
Ihain na may kasamang wasabi at toyo.

recipes.title: Malaysian Latok with Sambal Belacan & Calamansi
recipes.description: Fresh sea grapes paired with a spicy, citrusy, and savory pounded shrimp paste dip.
ingredients: 2 pieces fresh red bird's eye chilies (cili padi)
instructions: Wash latok thoroughly in clean water 2 to 3 times to remove any remaining sand or grit. Drain in a colander.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the chilies, toasted belacan, shallot, sugar, and salt into a textured paste. Squeeze the juice of two calamansi limes into the paste and stir.
Place the latok on a plate alongside extra calamansi halves and the sambal belacan dip. Dip the sea grapes into the sambal before eating.

filipino.title: Latok na Malaysian na may Sambal Belacan at Kalamansi
filipino.description: Sariwang sea grapes na inihain kasama ng maanghang, maasim, at malasang sawsawang dinikdik na bagoong-alamang.
instructions: Hugasan nang mabuti ang latok sa malinis na tubig nang 2 hanggang 3 ulit upang maalis ang natitirang buhangin o maliliit na dumi. Patuluin sa salaan.
Sa almires at pambayo, dikdikin ang mga sili, inihaw na belacan, sibuyas na pula, asukal, at asin hanggang maging magaspang na pasta. Pigaan ng katas ng dalawang kalamansi at haluin.
Ilagay ang latok sa plato, kasama ng mga natitirang hati ng kalamansi at sawsawang sambal belacan. Isawsaw ang sea grapes sa sambal bago kainin.

recipes.title: Sesame-Soy & Cucumber Sea Grape Salad
recipes.description: A crisp, modern cold salad featuring julienned cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and toasted sesame dressing.
ingredients: 1 piece Japanese or Persian cucumber (thinly julienned)
instructions: Whisk sesame oil, soy sauce, lemon juice, and honey in a bowl. Toss julienned cucumber and cherry tomatoes with half of the dressing.
Rinse sea grapes in cold water, dunk in an ice bath for 2 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
Arrange the dressed vegetables on a plate, lay the sea grapes across the top, drizzle with the remaining dressing right before serving, and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

filipino.title: Salad ng Sea Grape na may Sesame-Soy at Pipino
filipino.description: Malutong at makabagong malamig na salad na may hiniwang pahabang pipino, cherry tomato, at sawsawang inihaw na sesame.
ingredients: 1 Japanese o Persian na pipino (hiniwang pahaba at maninipis)
1 tbsp inihaw na buto ng sesame
1 tbsp toyo na kaunti ang sodium
instructions: Haluin sa mangkok ang sesame oil, toyo, katas ng lemon, at pulot-pukyutan. Ihalo ang hiniwang pahabang pipino at cherry tomato sa kalahati ng sawsawan.
Banlawan sa malamig na tubig ang sea grapes, ilubog sa tubig na may yelo nang 2 minuto, at patuluin nang mabuti.
Ayusin sa plato ang mga gulay na may sawsawan, ilatag sa ibabaw ang sea grapes, patakan ng natitirang sawsawan bago ihain, at budburan ng inihaw na buto ng sesame.
